title: docs(ui): platform-admin gate examples read isPlatformAdmin, not the legacy user.role scalar
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7dZ9akpF74wrKSmh623xwX)_

Fixes #28812

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:四处把 `user.role === 'admin'` 当作"管理员可见"的示例改成读 `isPlatformAdmin`:`evaluateVisibility` 的注释、`@object-ui/core` README 的 `evaluateExpression` 示例、ActionRunner 一处注释、`ui/docs/design/console-architecture.md` 的导航示例。只改注释和文档,没有代码行为变化。
- 为什么改:`user.role` 是 better-auth 的旧字段,ObjectStack 从不写它,开了 admin 插件后对所有人(包括平台管理员)都读作 `user`。照抄旧示例写出的 `visible` 条件对管理员永远不成立。文档里的平台管理员判断是 `current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true`。
- 风险与回滚:无运行时风险,只动注释、README 与设计文档;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx` 第 550 行附近的注释;`ui/packages/core/README.md` 的 Expressions 一节。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -nE "user\.role\s*={2,3}\s*['\"]admin['\"]" -- ui content/docs ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!**/*.test.*'`,预期只剩 `ui/CHANGELOG.md` 的历史条目和 `ui/packages/types/src/app.ts` 的一条测量记录(见下文为何保留)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`evaluateVisibility` docblock** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx`): the "template expression" bullet now reads `"${current_user.isPlatformAdmin === true}"` and says why not `user.role`. The bullet stays: a `${…}` template is still evaluated (it takes the legacy template path in `ExpressionEvaluator.evaluateCondition`, and `ExpressionProvider.evaluateVisibility.test.ts` "still evaluates ${…} template expressions" pins it).
- **`@object-ui/core` README**: the `evaluateExpression` example evaluates `${user.isPlatformAdmin === true}` against `{ user: { name: 'John', isPlatformAdmin: true } }` instead of `role: 'admin'`.
- **`ActionRunner.ts` `withIdentityAlias` comment**: the `os.user` alias example reads `os.user.isPlatformAdmin == true` instead of `os.user.role == "admin"`.
- **`ui/docs/design/console-architecture.md`**: the Expression-Based Visibility nav example reads `"${current_user.isPlatformAdmin === true}"`.
- **Changeset** `@object-ui/core: patch`: the README ships in the package (`files` lists `README.md`); precedent `.changeset/26080-readme-contributing-links.md`. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and the `ActionRunner` comment sits on a non-exported function, so neither ships a changed byte.

## Sweep (ruling 2): every hit of `user.role === 'admin'` / `== 'admin'`

Pattern `user\.role\s*={2,3}\s*['"]admin['"]` over `ui/**`, `content/docs/**`, `examples/**`, `skills/**` (it also matches `current_user.role` and `os.user.role`), read on `origin/main` `3e05ed1e`.

Fixed here (teachings):
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx:550`
- `ui/packages/core/README.md:71`
- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts:935`
- `ui/docs/design/console-architecture.md:132`

Left, with reason:
- `ui/CHANGELOG.md:527`: a historical changelog entry (release-owned record, like `content/docs/releases/**`). The pages it names (`MetadataManagerPage`, `UserManagementPage`) no longer exist under `ui/` (`git grep` finds them only in this changelog and a contributor guide).
- `ui/packages/types/src/app.ts:660`: records a measured `safeParse` refusal of a `hidden` string on the app node; it does not teach a gate.
- Test fixtures that build their own context with `role: 'admin'` and assert the evaluator's answer (not teachings): `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/formViewFeaturesRootRefused-6262.test.ts:46`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.landingMemberGates-12426.test.tsx:194,241`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.evaluateVisibility.test.ts:53`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.visibleFaultDiagnostic.test.ts:160`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.optionVisibleWhen.test.tsx:126`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/requiredInGatedSection.test.ts:50`, `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-actions.test.tsx:750,768`, `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionEngine.visibility.test.ts:197,219`, `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.conditionGate.test.ts:130,294`, `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.disabledGate.test.ts:190,216,370`, `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.test.ts:145`, `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/__tests__/ExpressionEvaluator.test.ts:606`, `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/__tests__/declaredPredicate.test.ts:110,111`, `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/__tests__/predicateInput.test.ts:57,158`, `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/app-hidden-catalogue-flag-7542.test.ts:124,129,130`, `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/navigation-model.test.ts:143`, `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/navigation-spec-parity.test.ts:339`.

Zero hits in `content/docs/**` (outside `releases/`), `examples/**` and `skills/**`. In `skills/**` the only nearby text is `skills/objectui/evals/auth-permissions.json:36`, a `must_not_contain` assertion that forbids `if (user.role ===`, which agrees with this change.

No shipped runtime gate reads `user.role === 'admin'` (ruling 3): the non-test `ui/**` readers of `user.role` are `useWorkspaceAdminStatus.ts:225` (one leg of an OR that also reads `isPlatformAdmin` and `positions`), `approvalsApi.ts:455` (identity ids, not a gate), `AuthGuard.tsx:78` (fallback when no `positions`) and `expressionUser.ts:170` (forwards the scalar).

## Tests

Comments and docs only, so no red-first test is owed (order). One throwaway probe, not kept, checked that the new examples open for a platform admin and the old one does not, on the provider's own bag (`buildExpressionScope` over `buildExpressionUser`):

<details><summary>Probe (deleted after the run)</summary>

- `evaluateVisibility("${current_user.isPlatformAdmin === true}", admin)` → `true`; same with a member (`isPlatformAdmin: false`) → `false`.
- `evaluateVisibility("${user.role === 'admin'}", admin)` → `false` (the bug: the admin's `role` is `user`).
- `evaluateExpression('${user.isPlatformAdmin === true}', { user: { name: 'John', isPlatformAdmin: true } })` → `true`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/providers/probe28812.test.ts` from `ui/`: `Tests 1 passed (1)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0. File removed; `git status` clean.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The condition builder offers two subjects that never gate on admin standing.** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ConditionBuilder.tsx:224-230` (`CONTEXT_SUBJECTS`) lists `user.role` (the legacy scalar, `user` for everyone) and `user.isAdmin`, a key the expression bag does not carry (`expressionUser.ts` builds `id`, `name`, `email`, `role`, `isPlatformAdmin`, `positions`). An author building an "admins only" row picks a subject that never opens. Not fixed here (runtime UI, outside this order's comments-and-docs surface); reported to the seat.
- `ui/packages/types/src/base.ts:405,427` and `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/predicateInput.ts:147` show `data.role === 'admin'`, a record field, not the user scalar; outside the ruling's pattern and left alone.

## Verification

Readings on the fix commit `3b3234bd`; after merging `origin/main` the derived gates were re-run on head `94dd3223`: all 28 plus `check:changeset-fixed` exit 0, `--ran` `28 derived, 28 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`.

<details><summary>Derived gates and package checks</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 28 commands; all 28 run, each exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` first answered exit 1 with every `@objectstack/client` import unresolved (its `dist/` was not built in this checkout); after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/client...' build` it answered exit 0, `169 passed | 2 skipped` files, `4900 passed | 2 skipped` tests. `--ran` reconciliation: `28 derived, 28 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`.
- Beyond the derivation: `pnpm check:changeset-fixed` exit 0. `pnpm check:published-readme-exports`: NOT MEASURED, exit 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: it reads every package's built `.d.ts`); CI runs it. The README still names only `evaluateExpression`, an export it named before.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core run type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` exit 0 (after building the app-shell dependency closure).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core run lint` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run lint` exit 0 (warnings only, none on a touched line).
- `pnpm check:nul-bytes`: exit 0.
- The repo-wide lint, `test:repo` and the full farm are CI's. Full dogfood not run: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.

</details>
